x-openregister.description: Additive fragment (ADR-037; OpenSpec change governance-body-events). Adds the provenance pair a governance body raised by ANOTHER app needs: sourceApp + externalReference. Together they are the idempotency key GovernanceBodyCommandService resolves on before writing, which is what makes a re-run of a cross-app migration update one body instead of minting a second. Decision already carries exactly this pair for exactly this reason. Both are optional: a body created through decidiq's own UI leaves them empty, and GovernanceBody.required is deliberately unchanged so no stored body becomes invalid.

sourceApp.title: Source app
sourceApp.description: App id of the fleet app that asked decidiq to raise this body (e.g. dossiq). Empty for bodies created in decidiq itself. Half of the idempotency key; never an authorization input.

externalReference.title: External reference
externalReference.description: The producing app's own id for the record this body was raised from. Paired with sourceApp it identifies the origin, so a repeated command updates this body rather than creating another.
